title: Blood Resonance Initially Manifests
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, the demonic army thousands of miles away had already begun mobilizing—the figure of the demonic envoy was racing toward the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: Just as Mo Xiansheng's voice fell, the third page of the Tianji Record suddenly glowed with a ghostly light, and a line of ancient seal script that had never appeared before slowly emerged—that was the core secret about the 'Heavenly Fate Key'. Chen Ji stared at that line of ancient script, his heart churning with tremendous waves. This passage not only revealed the truth behind Chen Nian being taken away by the Holy Sect, but also hinted at a possibility he had never imagined—the blood connection between him and Chen Nian might be one of the reasons the Tianji Record chose him.

dialogue.content: 'Do you see it?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the Void, 'The Heavenly Fate Key is not merely a container—it is the key to open the forbidden zone of the Heavenly Dao. And the blood resonance between you and Chen Nian is precisely the foundation upon which the Tianji Record can foresee the future.'

text.content: As Chen Ji was about to press for answers, a sudden wave of intense dizziness struck him. At his Brow Center, a faint blood-colored pattern suddenly illuminated, as if something was being awakened from the depths of his soul. At the same time, on the third page of the Tianji Record, that line of ancient script began to shake violently, emanating a breath that made Chen Ji feel a sense of dread.

This sensation... Chen Ji snapped his eyes wide open. In the misty visions granted by the Tianji Record, he had encountered this faint connection countless times, yet it had never felt so acute. It was a beckoning from the deepest part of his Bloodline, distant and unclear yet undeniably real. The pull pointed directly toward the location of the Demonic Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: 'Impossible...' Chen Ji murmured, his voice carrying a rare tremor. 'This perception is too distinct. Didn't they say that whenever Chen Nian was involved, the prophetic visions would blur? Why can I sense her presence so clearly right now?' His grip on the Tianji Record tightened, his knuckles whitening as a sense of foreboding surged through him.

text.content: Just then, a sharp Spiritual Energy fluctuation arrived from the distance. Chen Ji furrowed his brow and drew a special transmission talisman from his sleeve—the emergency contact method Ye Qing had given him when their partnership began. As the talisman burned, a familiar voice resonated in his mind, carrying an unprecedented urgency.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, something major has happened!' Ye Qing's voice held a rare hint of panic. 'Just now, the demonic army commander suddenly halted his attack deployment. He claims to have sensed an anomalous Blood Pulse and is mobilizing significant forces to track down the source. I suspect... this matter concerns you!'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank. He slowly raised his gaze to the third page of the Tianji Record, where that line of ancient script continued to quiver. Understanding struck him—the momentary Blood Resonance had not only allowed him to sense Chen Nian's presence, but had also alerted someone in the distant demonic realm. That individual was most likely the demonic army commander himself.

dialogue.content: 'I understand.' Chen Ji's voice emerged surprisingly composed, as if he had instantaneously regained his characteristic calm. 'Ye Qing, can you discover how many people the demonic commander has sent? What kind of formation?' he asked while rapidly calculating potential consequences in his mind.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed nearby. 'As expected. The connection between Heavenly Fate Keys is bidirectional—you can sense her, and she can sense you. The sole distinction is that you possess the Tianji Record to actively investigate, while she... is perhaps imprisoned somewhere, unable to respond.'

dialogue.content: 'According to my informant's report, the demonic commander dispatched a tracking squad composed of three Transcension Tribulation stage experts.' Ye Qing's voice transmitted through the talisman. 'They possess a special investigative technique that can trace targets along Blood Pulse trails. If they locate you...' She trailed off, but the danger was self-evident.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record's fragment warming in his palm. He could feel his Heavenly Fate value draining slowly—that involuntary Blood Resonance had cost him a full fifteen points of Heavenly Fate. This sacrifice far exceeded what active use of his Foresight Ability would have demanded. Yet it could not be helped—he could not pretend he had never sensed Chen Nian's existence.

choice.prompt: Blood Resonance has been triggered, and the demonic tracking squad is closing in. Chen Ji must make a decision within limited time—whether to hide and wait for the danger to pass, or to take the initiative and disrupt the enemy's arrangements.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to mask his aura, temporarily evade the demonic tracking squad's search. This is the safest choice, but might forfeit the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate value to conceal aura
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily escape tracking, gain buffer time
choices.risk_hint: The enemy might expand their search scope, affecting innocent bystanders

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his fingers gliding gently across the Tianji Record's cover. A faint golden light emanated from the fragment, completely sealing his presence. Simultaneously, he swiftly moved toward a concealed cave, preparing to wait out the danger.

choices.description: Proactively release a faint aura fluctuation to test the enemy's reaction and tracking limits. This is a risky strategy, but might acquire crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate value to test
choices.visible_reward: Acquire intelligence on the enemy's tracking range and capabilities
choices.risk_hint: Could expose more traces, increasing the risk of being tracked

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, revealing a dangerous arc. He deliberately released a faint blood pulse fluctuation, then quickly suppressed it. Through the foresight of the Tianji Record, he could sense the reactions of those three pursuers—their detection range was far more limited than he had anticipated.

choices.description: Unite with Ye Qing's strength, preemptively strike before the enemy discovers him, directly crush the pursuit team. This is the most aggressive strategy, but could also trigger larger conflicts.
choices.visible_cost: Could expose the alliance with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the threat and obtain intelligence on the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: The battle might attract more enemies' attention

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He transmitted a message to Ye Qing through a transmission talisman: 'Prepare for battle. I will set a trap on their inevitable path, and you will provide support. Tonight, we will let the Demonic Path commander know that those he sent will never return.'

Mr. Mo's remnant soul stood silently for a moment before speaking: 'The choice has been made, but no matter which path you choose, one thing you must understand—the connection between destined twins, once established, cannot truly be severed. You can sense her, and she can sense you. Unless...' His voice suddenly became profound, 'Unless you can find a way to completely resolve this problem.'

dialogue.content: 'Unless what?' Chen Ji pressed, urgency rising in his heart.

'Unless you can find another Heavenly Fate Lock.' Mr. Mo slowly stated, 'The Heavenly Eye has not placed just one piece on the world's board. If you can find a second lock and establish a second bloodline connection, perhaps you could distract the Demonic Path commander. But this path... is equally fraught with dangers.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation. He gazed down at the Tianji Record in his palm, various possibilities flashing rapidly through his mind. If he chose to hide, he could gain time to breathe, but the Demonic Path commander would not take this lying down. If he chose to probe, he might obtain crucial intelligence, but the risks were equally significant. As for taking the initiative to attack... while it most suited his character, the current balance of power was not optimistic.

dialogue.content: 'Whatever you plan to do,' Ye Qing's voice came again, 'my advice is to decide quickly. According to my intelligence, those three pursuers will arrive at the outer perimeter of the Tianqing Sect in at most two hours. If you have a plan, you'd better complete the arrangements before then. I will provide support from the shadows, but frontal combat... you know my situation.'

choice.prompt: Time was running out, and Ye Qing's reminder made the situation clearer. Chen Ji had to make his final decision within two hours.

choices.description: Utilize the foresight ability of the Tianji Record to pre-arrange illusion formations and traps at multiple locations, diverting the battlefield elsewhere.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 20 points of Heavenly Fate to set up multiple traps
choices.visible_reward: Buy space for retreat and counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate, affecting subsequent ability usage
choices.process_label: 利用天机录布置多重后手

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the foresight ability of the Tianji Record operating at full power. He saw the travel route of the three pursuers, and every terrain around the Tianqing Sect. Using this intelligence, he quickly marked five key positions on the map, each position suitable for setting up a simple illusion formation.

choices.description: Reveal part of the truth to Su Qingyao, seeking support from the Inner Sect of Tianqing Sect. This requires taking a certain risk of exposure.
choices.visible_cost: Could expose some strength and plans
choices.visible_reward: Obtain support from the Inner Sect of Tianqing Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might press for more details, making it difficult to fully control the situation
choices.process_label: 紧急联系苏青瑶寻求支援

dialogue.content: When Su Qingyao received Chen Ji's transmission, she was standing in the main hall of the Inner Sect. "Chen Ji?" Her voice carried a hint of surprise. "You're actually taking the initiative to contact me. Tell me, what's happened?"

choices.description: Deliberately releasing a conspicuous aura to lure the three pursuers toward a battlefield of his own choosing, where he would set an ambush together with Ye Qing.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high exposure risk; if the ambush fails, there will be no retreat
choices.visible_reward: If successful, can severely damage the Demonic Path's tracking forces and gain rich spoils
choices.risk_hint: An extremely dangerous strategy requiring flawless execution

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, a smile carrying a hint of madness. He said to Ye Qing: "Since they want to find me, let them find me. But where they find me, that will be decided by me." His fingers tapped lightly on the Tianji Record, his eyes gleaming with a dangerous light.

The moment Chen Ji made his decision, the third page of the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with dazzling light. The ancient seal script about the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" appeared completely before him, each character seeming to contain world-shattering power. At the same time, a blurry image flashed through his mind - Chen Nian's figure, imprisoned in a chamber filled with诡异符文, eyes tightly closed, yet seemingly undergoing some painful transformation.

dialogue.content: "Nian..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, his hands unconsciously clenching into fists. This was the first time he saw his sister's situation so clearly. The information from the Tianji Record was far more cruel than he imagined - Chen Nian was being used by the Holy Sect as the core vessel for cultivating the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," and this process was accelerating.

"Do you see it?" Mo Xiansheng's voice turned heavy. "This is the fate of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her bloodline is being extracted to open a door that should never be opened. And your existence is the catalyst accelerating this process. The stronger the connection between you, the faster she will be extracted."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time. When he spoke again, his voice had returned to its usual calm, but the killing intent within it was more intense than ever: "So, as long as I'm alive and maintain my blood connection with her, she will continue to be extracted at an accelerated rate?" Mo Xiansheng did not answer, but silence itself was the best answer.

choice.prompt: The cruel truth lay before him - Chen Ji's existence was accelerating his sister's death. He had to make the final decision in this crisis.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to actively sever the blood connection with Chen Nian, fundamentally slowing down the speed of her extraction. But this means he will forever lose the ability to sense her.
choices.visible_cost: Loss of bloodline sensing ability; may miss the timing for rescue
choices.visible_reward: Slow down the extraction speed of Chen Nian, buying more time for rescue
choices.risk_hint: After severance, may be unable to sense Chen Nian's specific location

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers pressing on the third page of the Tianji Record. A sharp pain came from his Brow Center, as if something was being forcibly torn apart. He could feel the subtle bond between himself and Chen Nian gradually fading, the call from the depths of his bloodline becoming distant and vague.

choices.description: Continue to maintain the blood connection with Chen Nian, even though this will accelerate her extraction. But at least he can still sense her, locate her.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the ability to sense her, facilitating positioning and rescue
choices.risk_hint: May allow the Holy Sect to complete the extraction process faster

dialogue.content: "No." Chen Ji's voice was calm and firm. "I will not sever my connection with her. Even if this connection accelerates her danger, I must see her with my own eyes and rescue her with my own hands." He raised his head, his gaze burning with unprecedented determination. "If the Holy Sect wants her bloodline, I simply will not let them have their way."

choices.description: Following Mo Xiansheng's hint, find another Heavenly Fate Lock Key to establish a second link, so as to divert the attention of the Demonic Path Commander and the Holy Sect.
choices.visible_cost: It will require consuming massive amounts of time and resources to search for clues.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, it can completely change the situation and gain strategic advantage.
choices.risk_hint: The process of searching for the second Lock Key may attract the attention of more forces.
choices.process_label: 开始寻找第二天命锁钥

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a decision. "Mo Xiansheng," he asked, "regarding the second Heavenly Fate Lock Key, are there other clues in the Tianji Record?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then slowly said, "The complete information on the third page should contain related content. But to fully interpret it, you need more Heavenly Fate Value as support."

Just then, a sudden and intense Spiritual Energy Fluctuation came from the distance. Chen Ji furrowed his brows and looked toward the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. There, three powerful auras were approaching at extreme speed, each radiating a terrifying might—the unique aura of Tribulation Transcendence experts. The Demonic Path tracking squad had arrived faster than anticipated.

dialogue.content: "There's no time!" Ye Qing's voice came urgently through the Sound Transmission Talisman. "They arrived half an hour earlier than I expected! Now you must make an immediate choice—fight or flee?"

Chen Ji slowly stood up and tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve. There was no panic on his face; instead, he wore a faint smile. He said to Ye Qing, "Don't rush. Combat doesn't always have to be frontal. Since they're arriving so quickly, let me send them a grand gift."

text.content: He raised his hand and drew a rune in the air, a special secret technique recorded in the Tianji Record—"Heavenly Fate Misguidance". By consuming a certain amount of Heavenly Fate Value, he could create false aura fluctuations in a specific area, leading trackers in the wrong direction. This was one of his prepared backup plans, originally meant for dealing with even more difficult situations, never expecting it would be useful so soon.

As the rune took shape, a false aura extremely similar to Chen Ji's Blood Pulse shot off in the opposite direction at high speed. Meanwhile, Chen Ji himself concealed all his aura, and using the Tianji Record's concealment function, disappeared from the spot as if merging into the void. He believed that at least for a short time, the three trackers would be misled by the false aura, buying him precious time to catch his breath.

dialogue.content: "Good." Chen Ji said in a low voice, "Now, let's see where this chase truly leads." He turned and rushed in the opposite direction, simultaneously sending a message to Ye Qing through the Sound Transmission Talisman: "Plan changed. Before the trackers realize they've been deceived, we need to find their real target one step faster—my sister, Chen Nian."

text.content: Ye Qing's voice came again, carrying a hint of surprise: "You've decided? To make a move against the Holy Sect at this time?" Chen Ji didn't answer directly, merely saying calmly: "When prey begins to fight back, hunters are often unprepared. I want the Demonic Path Commander to know that what he thought was a soft persimmon is actually a stone that bites back."

The third page of the Tianji Record in his sleeve grew slightly warm, and that line of ancient script about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key seemed to respond to his determination. Chen Ji knew that from this moment, everything was different. He was no longer prey passively evading, but a chess player beginning to set up the board. And the first piece he would place was his sister, Chen Nian, who was far within the depths of the Holy Sect, her bloodline being extracted.

As night deepened, three black shadows swept through the forest outside Tianqing Sect like a whirlwind. They were the tracking squad dispatched by the Demonic Path Commander, each a genuine Tribulation Transcendence expert. Yet at this moment, they were being pulled by a false aura fluctuation, rushing toward a completely wrong direction. The leading old man suddenly stopped, a hint of confusion flickering in his turbid old eyes: "This aura... why has it suddenly become so blurred?" What he didn't know was that not far behind them, a pair of calm eyes was watching their every move through the darkness of night.
